title: Hawaiian-Style Sausage and Rice
description: Smoked sausages, vegetables, and pineapple chunks cooked in a thick, savory-sweet sauce create a Hawaiian-style recipe to serve over lots of hot rice.
ingredients: 1 large green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 cup diagonally sliced celery, 1 inch thick
1 (14 ounce) can whole peeled tomatoes, quartered
1 (8 ounce) can pineapple rings in juice, cubed and juice reserved

steps.text: Bring 4 cups water and rice to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes.
Place sausages and remaining 1/2 cup water in a large skillet over medium heat, cover, and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Thinly slice sausages.
Return sausages to the skillet. Add onion, bell pepper, and celery; cook over medium heat until vegetables start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir tomatoes, beef broth, pineapple cubes, brown sugar, garlic powder, and black pepper into sausage mixture; cook and stir until sugar has dissolved and mixture comes to a simmer.
Whisk reserved pineapple juice and cornstarch together in a small bowl until smooth; stir into sausage mixture. Cook until sauce thickens, about 2 minutes; serve over rice.
